vocabulary.Booking: A reservation linking a User to a Flight with passenger count, total price, and status (PENDING/CONFIRMED/CANCELLED).
vocabulary.Payment: A payment record linked to a Booking, with transaction ID, amount, and status (PENDING/COMPLETED/REFUNDED).
vocabulary.Flight: A scheduled flight with origin, destination, departure/arrival times, price, and seat availability.
vocabulary.Role: User authorization level — USER (regular customer) or ADMIN (full management access).
